To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

UFMC is the best choice in terms of time-frequency efficiency for short burst transmissions with very tight latency requirements, while OFDM and FBMC are more suitable for long sequences with less strict latency requirements.
FBMC performs best for long sequences, while OFDM and UFMC perform best for short sequences.

(i) OFDM is the least efficient waveform, especially for very short bursts, (ii) FBMC is the most efficient waveform when the sequence length is large, (iii) UFMC is the best waveform when the sequence has to be short.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and analysis of novel signal processing techniques for wireless communication systems with an emphasis on the physical layer.
the suitability of different multicarrier wave forms for 5G networks.
the design of a new waveform for future wireless systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
FBMC is a good choice for long packet transmissions and UFMC is the better choice for short packet transmission.
UFMC is the best choice for short burst transmissions with low latency requirements.
FBMC is a good choice for long packets and OFDM is a good choice in case of very tight response time constraints.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
OFDM is not a good candidate for the air interface for 5G, while FBMC and UFMC are.
UFMC is the best choice for 5G in case of short packets and low latency requirements.
FBMC is the most efficient waveform for long sequences, OFDM for very short sequences (e.g. less than 4 OFDM symbols) and UFMC for all the other cases.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the choice of waveform is not only important for the long packets, which is the case for today's cellular networks, but also for short packets.
the choice of the waveform is not as straightforward as it might have seemed before, but it depends on the application and its requirements.
the choice of the modulation scheme is very important for the 5G air interface, especially when considering the use of very short packets or when the response times are very tight.
